questions.solution_en: \(\begin{aligned} &= \sqrt{\frac{cosec A + 1}{cosec A - 1}} + \sqrt{\frac{cosec A - 1}{cosec A + 1}} \\ &= \sqrt{\frac{1 + \sin A}{1 - \sin A}} + \sqrt{\frac{1 - \sin A}{1 + \sin A}} \\ &= \sqrt{\frac{(1 + \sin A)^2}{1 - \sin^2 A}} + \sqrt{\frac{(1 - \sin A)^2}{1 - \sin^2 A}} \\ &= \frac{1 + \sin A}{\cos A} + \frac{1 - \sin A}{\cos A} \\ &= \frac{2}{\cos A} = 2\sec A \end{aligned}\)
questions.solution_hi: \(\begin{aligned} &= \sqrt{\frac{cosec A + 1}{cosec A - 1}} + \sqrt{\frac{cosec A - 1}{cosec A + 1}} \\ &= \sqrt{\frac{1 + \sin A}{1 - \sin A}} + \sqrt{\frac{1 - \sin A}{1 + \sin A}} \\ &= \sqrt{\frac{(1 + \sin A)^2}{1 - \sin^2 A}} + \sqrt{\frac{(1 - \sin A)^2}{1 - \sin^2 A}} \\ &= \frac{1 + \sin A}{\cos A} + \frac{1 - \sin A}{\cos A} \\ &= \frac{2}{\cos A} = 2\sec A \end{aligned}\)

questions.q_en: A travelled from a place P to place Q at an average speed of 36 km/h. He travelled the first 75% of the distance in four-fifth of the time and the rest at a constant speed of x km/h. The value of x is:
questions.q_hi: A ने स्थान P से स्थान Q तक 36 किमी/घंटा की औसत गति से यात्रा की। उसने पहले 75% दूरी 4/5वें समय में तथा शेष दूरी x किमी/घंटा की स्थिर गति से तय की। x का मान है:
options_en:
45

    40

    60    

    50
questions.solution_en:
Let the time = t
Total distance =36 × t = 36t
First 75% of the distance = 36t × = 27t
Remaining Distance = 36t - 27t = 9t
Remaining Time = t - (4/5) t = = t/5
Speed x= = 9 × 5 = 45km/h
